title: URIS: Unified Reasoning Intelligence System
summary: URIS is a multi-agent AI-readiness platform where specialized agents plan, evaluate, enforce compliance, synthesize, and validate tabular datasets with an audit trail. Its Synthesis Agent directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a detected Metadata object to generate synthetic rows that fix class imbalance and sparse columns.
needs: README also claims CTGAN is used for categorical-heavy datasets, but no CTGAN call site was found in the evidence.
